title: Extended dynamic mode decomposition with Fourier dictionaries: Error bounds and fast implementation
summary: The Koopman operator has gained considerable attention in dynamical systems due to its capability to provide a linear viewpoint for nonlinear systems using data-driven methods such as extended dynamic mode decomposition (EDMD). In this work, we propose an EDMD-variant with a Fourier dictionary on the $d$-dimensional torus, where the data are sampled on an equispaced tensor grid. We show that the EDMD regression problem admits a unique closed-form solution and coincides with trigonometric interpolation of the Koopman image. This identification has two consequences.
